admin.n8n_social.heading: n8n social publishing setup
admin.n8n_social.intro: Connect n8n to Timeblock source data, AI copy/media generation, and Facebook, TikTok, and LINE publishing workflows.
admin.n8n_social.api_enabled_note: Enable with SOCIAL_AGENT_API_ENABLED=true only after token setup.
admin.n8n_social.token_note: n8n must send Authorization: Bearer SOCIAL_AGENT_API_TOKEN.
admin.n8n_social.ai_note: GPT-5.6 Luna handles text, image analysis, and cited web research through the Responses API.
admin.n8n_social.workspace_note: Quota -1 means unlimited for the internal admin workspace. Paid member and business workspaces should use explicit monthly quotas.
admin.n8n_social.workspace_form: Create or update a paid workspace
admin.n8n_social.approval_note: High-risk drafts should stay in review before publishing.
admin.n8n_social.facebook_note: Requires FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID and FACEBOOK_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN from Meta Graph API.
admin.n8n_social.tiktok_note: Requires TikTok client keys and a user access token with posting permission. Public posting needs platform audit.
admin.n8n_social.line_note: Requires LINE_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN for Messaging API push or broadcast nodes.
admin.n8n_social.media_note: Configure image and video providers in n8n; Timeblock stores asset URLs and metadata.
admin.n8n_social.no_drafts: n8n has not saved social drafts yet.
admin.n8n_social.no_metrics: No social analytics callback has been received.
admin.n8n_social.no_video_jobs: n8n has not claimed a video job yet.
admin.n8n_social.ingestion_policy: Only RSS, Meta Graph API, and licensed Shopee Product Feed/Open API inputs are accepted. Browser session scraping is not used.
admin.n8n_social.no_imports: No official-source content has been imported.
admin.n8n_social.no_share_reviews: No share evidence is waiting for review.
